subsubthemes.name: Learning fast replacements for equations
subsubthemes.gist: Training neural networks to predict system behavior instead of running expensive simulations, so scientists can explore what-if scenarios quickly.

subsubthemes.name: Adding physics rules to neural learning
subsubthemes.gist: Forcing neural networks to respect the laws of physics (like energy conservation or differential equations) during training, so they stay realistic even on new data.

subsubthemes.name: Solving equations with neural networks
subsubthemes.gist: Using neural networks directly to find solutions to partial differential equations and complex mathematical problems instead of traditional numerical methods.

subsubthemes.name: Learning from molecular and biological simulations
subsubthemes.gist: Building neural models that capture how molecules move, proteins fold, and cells change over time, compressing years of molecular data into learnable patterns.

subsubthemes.name: Transforming data into simpler forms
subsubthemes.gist: Finding hidden patterns and lower-dimensional representations of complex systems so they become easier to model and forecast.

subsubthemes.name: Connecting neural networks to classical math techniques
subsubthemes.gist: Building neural networks inspired by spectral methods, Fourier transforms, and Green's functions so they inherit the mathematical power of classical PDE solvers.
